g.text: Figure 4. Conditional expected time-to-attack predictions from saved CR-LSTM and CR-TCN development-validation results.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #47586a

g.text: Density panels use a common logarithmic count scale. The dashed diagonal represents perfect ETA prediction; the CDF shows absolute error.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #47586a

g.text: Positive signed error means the model predicts more time remaining than actually exists; negative error means it predicts less.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c6d80

g.text: Synthetic NAF v2 development validation. ETA is evaluated conditional on a true future attack. Windows overlap in time; confidence intervals and end-to-end onset accuracy are not implied.
